job.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer — Series A-Track Deep Tech Startup London (In-Person) | 996 Schedule — San Francisco Model

 

The Opportunity: One of the most exciting early-stage companies in the UK right now is on a mission to eliminate the last great barriers to progress in the physical world. While software has transformed how we communicate, shop, and entertain — industries like aerospace, healthcare, and energy are still being held back by outdated, manual systems. This company is changing that.

They're building the infrastructure that lets complex, real-world work move at software speed — and they're looking for builders who want to be at the centre of it.

 

The Backing: This isn't a bet — it's a sure thing in the making. The company recently closed a $4.5M seed round that was 14× oversubscribed, backed by Tier-1 VCs with founding teams from Coinbase, Reddit, Klarna, and Spotify. A Series A is on the immediate horizon. You'll be joining at the exact right moment — early enough to have genuine equity impact, late enough to know the fundamentals are proven.

 

The Team: World-class. Former founding engineers from unicorn companies, and talent from X, Google, Amazon, and Yandex. High standards, high trust, zero politics. This is a team that wants to win — and has the track record to do it.

 

The Role: This is not a ticket-taker position. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the bridge between customers and product. You will sit with users, decide what should exist, build it end-to-end, and put it in their hands — fast.

 

You'll own real product surface area from Day 1. That means customer calls in the morning, shipping to production in the afternoon.

 

What you'll actually do:
  • Embed with customers to understand their real workflows — not what they say they want, but what they actually need
  • Design and build end-to-end user workflows, from UI through to backend logic and data
  • Translate messy, real-world processes into clean, intuitive software
  • Integrate AI-powered features — LLMs, agents, model-backed APIs — into production workflows
  • Write the spec, build it, ship it, own it

 

What We're Looking For

 

Technically:
  • Strong TypeScript and modern frontend (React or equivalent)
  • Backend services in Python
  • Production AI integration experience (LLMs, agents, model-backed APIs)
  • Ability to reason about complex workflows — not just CRUD
Culturally:
  • You want ownership, not a job description
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and evolving requirements
  • You can hold your own on a customer call with non-technical domain experts
Strong plus:
  • Founder or ex-founder background
  • Palantir, Ramp, Scale, or similar forward-deployed / solutions engineering experience
  • Fellowship alumni: EF, YC, Antler, or equivalent
  • Early-stage or stealth startup experience

 

The Deal:
  • 📍 In-person, London — visa sponsorship available
  • ✈️ Relocation fully covered — visas, meals, and tools handled
  • ⏱️ 996 schedule (San Francisco model) — this is a high-intensity, high-reward environment for people who want to build something that matters
  • 🚀 Equity at a pre-Series A valuation with 14× oversubscribed seed momentum behind it

 

If you want a 9-to-5, this isn't it. If you want to build something that changes how the physical world operates — and you want to do it with some of the best engineers in the room — let's talk.

Strong experience as a Product Manager working on websites, landing pages or e-commerce products

Hands-on experience running A/B tests and building experimentation frameworks

Data-driven mindset with the ability to turn insights into clear product decisions

Proven track record improving conversion and performance metrics

High ownership and strong execution focus

Firmware Project Manager, Up to $60k base, Remote, EU, Electronics, Hardware, EVT, DVT, PVT

 

My client is building a consumer hardware platform that combines custom electronics, embedded software, its own operating system and system applications to deliver a unique interactive experience. The product is already live and continues to evolve across new hardware revisions and firmware platforms.

 

We are hiring a Firmware Project Manager with a strong embedded background and hands on experience across firmware development, hardware interface testing and new platform bring up. This role sits at the centre of firmware execution, coordinating work from early hardware prototypes through validation, stable releases and production readiness.

 

You will work closely with firmware, hardware, QA, mobile and backend teams, structuring complex engineering work and driving predictable delivery while staying close to the technical details.

 

What you will do

 

You will own execution of the firmware development cycle, breaking product requirements into actionable firmware tasks, planning sprints, estimating work and tracking progress across teams. You will coordinate development of low level drivers, system modules, connectivity and device logic, ensuring alignment with requirements and delivery timelines.

You will lead firmware and hardware integration, coordinating power states, protocols, timing, calibration and thresholds. You will work with hardware and QA to identify root causes of integration issues and ensure stable system behaviour across hardware revisions.

You will lead bring up and validation for new boards and device revisions, including bootloaders, clocks, power rails and drivers. You will establish diagnostics, debug tooling and logging for early stage testing, and coordinate validation across EVT, DVT and PVT phases.

You will translate product requirements into clear technical specifications for firmware engineers, maintain internal documentation and diagrams, and facilitate communication across firmware, hardware, QA, backend and product teams. You will highlight risks, blockers and dependencies early.

You will define firmware quality gates, manage builds and release notes, coordinate regression testing and drive post release improvements.

 

What we are looking for

 

You have 5 or more years of experience in embedded systems, firmware engineering leadership, QA leadership or technical project management. You have experience with hardware bring up, low level debugging and manufacturing phases such as EVT, DVT and PVT. You understand embedded system constraints around memory, power and timing, and can translate product level requirements into executable technical work.

You are structured, calm and methodical, with clear communication across engineering and product teams.

Nice to have

Hands on firmware development experience in C or C++, or scripting in Python or Bash. Experience with consumer electronics, IoT or robotics. Experience building diagnostic or testing frameworks. Startup experience with fast development cycles.
